# Pull request

## Problem

<!-- What observable behavior or architecture gap does this address? -->

## Change

<!-- Describe the source of truth, seams, and user path changed. -->

## Status and evidence

<!-- Implemented, documented provider behavior, experimentally verified, proposed, unsupported, or unknown. Link primary sources where relevant. -->

## Authority and privacy

<!-- Tools, permissions, approvals, retention, network exposure, context, narration, and private-data impact. -->

## Verification

<!-- Focused commands and exact results. Include schema, Mermaid, link, privacy, and provider evidence when applicable. -->

## Migration, fallback, and rollback

<!-- Explain existing data behavior, unsupported-provider fallback, and safe disable/revert path. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and does not include unrelated local/generated work.
- [ ] Current behavior and draft proposals are clearly distinguished.
- [ ] Canonical identities and sources of truth remain explicit.
- [ ] Permission requirements cannot be weakened by collaboration settings.
- [ ] Raw tools, logs, code, and private agent discussion cannot enter speech.
- [ ] Voice and coding-agent usage remain separate.
- [ ] Relevant focused tests pass.
- [ ] `npm run privacy-check` passes.
- [ ] Documentation links and Mermaid diagrams validate when changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private histories, personal exports, or proprietary code are included.
